note: Levo' chamat is best taken as the town name Lebo (modern Lebweh) "of Hamath"; KJV renders it "the entrance of Hamath".

kjv: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received
mine: With the other half of Manasseh the Reubenites and the Gadites received
note: 'Immo "with it/him" must refer to the eastern half of Manasseh (the text appears to have lost words by haplography); KJV's "with whom" links it grammatically to the western half-tribe just named, which received no land east of the Jordan.
